name: Verify ROSAOCMRoleConfig
description: Verify ROSAOCMRoleConfig lifecycle: creation, reconciliation, status field population, and safe Retain deletion policy on shared AWS account

playbooks.name: Verify ROSAOCMRoleConfig
playbooks.description: Tests ROSAOCMRoleConfig creation, readiness polling, status verification, and safe teardown with Retain policy

documentation.overview: This test suite verifies the ROSAOCMRoleConfig CRD and controller. It validates that the controller reconciles existing account roles, queries OCM organization linkage, marks the CR Ready, populates roleARN and organizationID, and safely removes finalizers on deletion without unlinking the shared account.
prerequisites: OpenShift hub cluster with CAPA controller supporting ROSAOCMRoleConfig
Valid OpenShift cluster login credentials configured in vars/user_vars.yml or environment
